name: ci-retained-source
goal: Fresh main checks retain immutable source reviews after squash landing

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Cold single-branch clone of the exact source tree fails 12 ownership cases without archived commits and passes the same unchanged cases after fetching refs/harness/source. Actual main unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard Linux setup case asserts complete branch history but omits archived source refs. Extend that same setup case with read ordering before the unchanged full check.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 8505d777 at fecd895df fails the existing Linux setup case on missing retained source refs. Five remaining setup cases pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: a1d1fb8f4 reads archived source refs before unchanged verification with the public remote and read-only repository permissions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed unchanged green a62ee8d4 at a1d1fb8f4 passes all six CI cases in the same recording process. The cold-clone proof separately passes all 12 unchanged ownership cases after this fetch.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: All six standard CI setup and security cases pass at a1d1fb8f4. A cold single-branch clone proves 12 unchanged ownership cases fail before archive retrieval and pass afterward. No runtime or UI behavior changed.
